Brief received

Thank you.

Your brief is with us and a confirmation is on its way to your inbox. It's been passed to My Event Match so relevant photographers and videographers can review it.

  1. 1We match your briefDate, location, coverage and style are used to identify professionals who genuinely suit what you've described.
  2. 2They come back with workYou'll hear back with portfolios, availability and pricing — usually within one to two business days.
  3. 3You compare and chooseLook at the actual work before you talk to anyone, then book direct. No obligation either way.
